item: Bellagio Saturday buy-in conflicts
detail: PDF heading reads $1100 buy-in; the file name reads $1000; the rules allocate a $600 buy-in. Recorded as $600 from the rules text.

item: Bellagio Saturday PDF lists a past Day 2 date
detail: Rules say 'Combined Final Day 2 (9/13/26)'. That date is before today (2026-11-16) and the PDF may be an old template.

item: Bellagio poker page weekday does not match the date
detail: Page says tournament play 'will resume on Saturday, July 26'. July 26, 2026 is a Sunday (July 26, 2025 was a Saturday). The page looks stale; the date was not used.

item: Venetian $300 house fee differs between two structure sheets
detail: Structure #5 withholds $58 (prize pool $242). Structure #10 withholds $60 (prize pool $240). Both are $300 1-Day or Day 1 events. The prize-pool figure used in the breakeven math comes from each event's own sheet.

item: Venetian $400 house fee differs between two structure sheets
detail: Structure #2/#3 withholds $70 (prize pool $330). Structure #6 withholds $65 (prize pool $335).

item: Venetian series page still shows a finished series
detail: The DeepStack page still references the WPT Fall Festival, which ended Nov 15, 2026, before the as-of date (2026-11-16).

item: Wynn 'Single Day' label conflicts with re-entry terms
detail: Wynn's Mon-Thu and Sat/Sun daily events allow re-entry at the entry fee, so they are excluded from the single-entry list.

item: Official Wynn links return a 'checked out' page
detail: https://www.wynnlasvegas.com/Casino/Poker was removed, and https://www.wynnlasvegas.com/hotel shows a 'checked out' page. Neither is used as a source.

item: Official Venetian tournaments page returns 404
detail: https://www.venetianlasvegas.com/resort/casino/poker/tournaments.html returns a 404. The working schedule is the DeepStack series page.

item: WSOP Las Vegas 2026 has ended; no Las Vegas events on the WSOP schedule for Nov-Dec 2026
detail: The official WSOP.com schedule was checked for Nov 16 to Dec 23, 2026 and lists no Las Vegas events in that window. It was not used as a tournament source.

item: Venetian 'Single Day' events may still include bounties and late registration
detail: Structure sheets list late-registration windows. Late registration was not treated as a re-entry. Confirm with the room if it counts as a second entry.

item: Resort fees: Bellagio, ARIA, Venetian, Palazzo, Caesars Palace
detail: No official resort-fee page was retrieved for these properties. Third-party sites conflict: Bellagio and ARIA appear at $50 on one list and $55 on others.

item: Wynn resort fee: official terms used
detail: Official Wynn terms state a $55 resort fee plus tax. The official figure is used; third-party figures are not used for Wynn.

item: Clark County lodging tax (13.38%) not confirmed from an official page
detail: The rate is reported by third-party sites that cite Clark County. The official Clark County tax page was not retrieved.

item: Aria has no official daily tournament schedule on its poker page
detail: The official ARIA poker page says daily tournaments must be confirmed by phone at 702.590.7232, and it has no tournament list. Third-party listings were not used.

item: Resorts World poker page has no tournament schedule
detail: The official Resorts World poker-room page covers dining only. No official tournament schedule was found.

item: MGM Grand schedule not confirmed from an official source
detail: Only a PokerAtlas calendar, dated 2025, was found. It is treated as stale and was not used.

item: Wynn WPT events: re-entry terms not reviewed
detail: 46 rows from the official WPT schedule (Nov 27 to Dec 13) are listed, but none was checked against the terms for re-entry. The Dec 13 'Day 1A' row reads '$1,000,000 added*' with no guarantee given in the row; the asterisk was not resolved.

item: Wynn nightly $160 event: structure not reviewed
detail: Listed on the official daily poster. Re-entry terms are unknown, so the event is not placed in either section.

item: 31 Venetian entry-level events have unread structure sheets
detail: These events are on the official schedule (dates, times, buy-ins, guarantees confirmed) but their single-entry status is not confirmed. The status column in Single-entry tournaments shows which ones.

item: Room rates and walking times are not verified for any hotel
detail: Official static pages do not publish nightly rates for the dates in question. Walking distances were not measured from an official source. Both columns are blank.
